spans.s:
m. (-तुः)
Absence of cause or reason.
E.
अ neg. हेतु cause.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Causeless, groundless.
E.
अ neg. हेतुक having cause.

f. (-ता)
Absence of cause or necessity.
E.
तल् added to अहेतु.

n. (-त्वं)
Absence of reason or cause.
E.
त्व added to अहेतु.

f. (-रुः)
A plant, (Asparagus racemosus): see शतमूली.
E.
अ neg. हि to go, and रु affix; immoveable; alluding to the number of its roots.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Belonging, or relating to a snake.
E.
अहि a snake, and ढञ् aff.
